races.name: British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: It's hard to see past SOD HALL LANE who has made a bright start and came clear in good style at Hamilton 4 weeks ago.

races.verdict: DUCHESS OF IMMATIN has improved with each start to date, subject to no more than largely hands-and-heels riding when opening her account at Kempton last week. She looks to have been found an excellent opportunity on nursery debut with further progress in the offing. Bladey Lady can emerge as the chief danger back down in class.

Gilna's Of Laytown Optional Claiming Maiden
races.verdict: NAUTIC STAR has been out of the frame just once in her 8 career starts and this looks a good opportunity for Jessica Harrington's filly to get off the mark. Heading up the dangers is Donna Time, who found listed company all too much on just her fourth career start in the summer but can get back on track returning in much calmer waters. Elusive Path and Senna's Girl round off the shortlist.

Time Test filly who progressed gradually in maidens, second of 8 at Naas (1m) in July. Wasn't good enough up in grade at Killarney (1m, good) later that month and off since. Better anticipated returned to calmer waters.

Has failed to beat a rival in 2 maidens (gelded after debut).
Consistent filly who has made the frame all 6 starts this year, most recently when fourth of 17 in maiden at Fairyhouse (7f, good) 9 days ago. Should be thereabouts again.

Failed to progress in 3 outings for William Haggas in 2024/25. After 15 months off, probably needed the outing when sixth of 9 in maiden at Laytown (7f) just under 3 weeks ago, so this run should reveal more.
Ran to a decent level when third at Down Royal in July but hasn't come close to reproducing it in 4 subsequent outings.

Maiden who has been well below par on his last 3 starts, latest minus his usual cheekpieces. Does have bits and pieces of form in the book that would give him a squeak but hard to be confident he can reproduce it.
Down the field in a trio of maidens on the level for Miss Natalia Lupini and again offered little sent hurdling after 3 months off at Down Royal last month.

Went without equipment for the first time in her career and put up one of her best efforts when third of 14 in handicap at Clonmel (1¼m, good) a fortnight ago. Tongue tie reapplied and wouldn't be sure to reproduce that

races.name: Gilna's Of Laytown Optional Claiming Maiden
Weatherbys Racing Bank Selling Stakes
races.verdict: WALSINGHAM is favoured by the weights dropped into selling company and is fancied to resume winning ways at the chief expense of stablemate Kaleido who also holds solid claims on these terms. Hat-trick seeking Sunriseontheboyne and Nostrum can't be dismissed either in a competitive event.

runners.note: Completed a second double of his career in the Carlisle Bell in June. Has found things tougher since, retried in cheekpieces when only sixth of 9 in handicap at Chester (7.6f, good to soft) 18 days ago. Not out of things
Back in fine form of late and bids for a hat-trick following gutsy wins at Newcastle (1m) and in 10-runner handicap over C&D (good to firm) recently. Has more to do on these terms but not dismissed.
Scored at Pontefract (1m) in April and back in good nick of late, third of 10 in handicap there (1m, good to soft) 13 days ago. Big shout at these weights lowered into selling company.

Smart earlier in his career but struggled for David O'Meara in 2025. More encouraging signs for current yard when fifth of 9 in handicap at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) 11 days ago. Needs to build on it back up in trip.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Beginners Chase
races.verdict: FUTURE PROSPECT can provide Willie Mullins and Paul Townend with a third successive win in this contest. Amen Kate and Sixandahalf are useful hurdlers and may give her most to do if taking to fences.

runners.note: Likeable and straightforward mare who won a 2m mares listed novice hurdle at Thurles (good to soft) last December. Found it harder in graded company in the spring but still rates a good chase prospect.

Bumper/hurdle winner who has shown fairly useful form when runner-up on all 3 completed starts over fences, most recently to a talented stablemate at Tramore (2¾m, good to firm) 45 day ago. Won't be inconvenienced by the
Fair chaser but likely vulnerable to higher-rated rivals kept to maiden company.
Fair winning hurdler in France in 2024. Hasn't shown a great deal on either start for current connections, including when always behind on last month's Wexford chase debut after a long absence.

Useful hurdler. Off since finishing well held in the County at the Cheltenham Festival in March. Has the ability to make an impact in these sort of races but isn't the biggest.

races.name: EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: GOLD KEY got a much fairer crack at things and duly stepped up plenty on his debut effort when finishing a very good second behind a subsequent winner at Thirsk 7 weeks ago. Open to further progress, he can confirm the promise of that run and make it third time lucky. Rupert The Brave has gone the right way in 3 starts to date and is a live threat from a handy draw, with Muhandes expected to build

runners.note: Dark Angel colt. Dam 2-y-o 5f-6f winner. Very green and soon off bridle when fifth of 6 in a Ffos Las maiden (6f) 5 weeks ago. This promises to reveal more but rates best watched for the time being.

Starman half-brother to 2-y-o 7f winner Mariha. Low-key start in pair of turf novice/maidens at up to 7f in recent weeks but represents a top stable and he could be an interesting type for nurseries on the back of this.
Gleneagles colt who is likely to need time and distance and he offered little when last of 7 in a Hamilton maiden (8.3f, soft) on debut 10 days ago.

€62,000 Palace Pier colt who wasn't seen to best effect on debut and duly left that form well behind when second in 5-runner novice at Thirsk (7f) last month, quickening entering straight and headed final 100 yds. Should

Showcasing gelding who showed promise and looked a threat before tiring late on when finishing a close-up fifth of 9 in a Leicester novice (7f) 3 weeks ago. In good hands and he can be expected to build on that.

Foaled April 15. €200,000 yearling, Wootton Bassett colt. Brother to smart French 9f/1¼m winner Dream Works and useful winner in France up to 9.7f Dune. Dam unraced. Makes appeal on paper so one to note in the betting fo

Progressive son of Phoenix Of Spain who ran well in a first-time tongue strap when third of 9 in novice at Kempton (7f) 16 days ago, forcing a brisk gallop and losing out only late on. Feasible to think he could take som

Too Darn Hot filly. Dam, 1¼m winner. On her toes beforehand (easy to back) and offered little when seventh of 8 in a Sandown maiden (7f, soft) 32 days ago. Represents top yard but looks one for further down the line.

races.name: Best Odds At Oddschecker Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
BOYLE Sports Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict: THE BLUE PANTHER went close from this mark on his penultimate start and now starting out for another new yard in reapplied cheekpieces, he's put forward as the answer. Last-time-out winners Platino Bianco and Chavajod look the most obvious threats, with Are You In Or Out one to keep an eye on at forecast longer odds from her much-reduced mark.

runners.note: No impact in 1m handicaps at the Curragh the last twice and seems better on all-weather. Returns from 3 months off.
Successful at Gowran this time last year. Form patchy this season but claims on his Leopardstown efforts (better than bare result in race that worked out last month).
Shaped as if still in good heart after 12 weeks off when fourth at Gowran earlier in the month but not in the same form back there (1m, soft) 11 days ago. Bounce back required.
Twenty-three runs since last win in 2023 and continues to fall in the weights without showing much sign of taking advantage.
Maiden who fared little better than on recent stable debut in first-time cheekpieces when seventh of 15 at Listowel (1m, good to soft) 9 days ago.

Has popped up with handicap wins in 2024/2025, and he went close to opening his account for this year (denied a clear run) in a similar event at Gowran in July. Ran poorly at Leopardstown last time (drawn wide) and could

Enhanced her good record fresh when scoring at Fairyhouse in May but has lost her form since. Back up in trip and reunited with Chris Hayes, she could be worth a second glance from a much-reduced mark.
C&D winner last year who also scored in first-time cheekpieces at Naas (1m) in July. Struggling for form at present, though, including in a claimer at Laytown last time.

Capitalised on a falling mark rather out of the blue in 10-runner event at Laytown (7f) just under 3 weeks ago, edging ahead close home. Cheekpieces back on but he doesn't appeal as the type to follow up.
Fourteen runs since last win in 2025 and yet to give her running on turf this year.
Capitalised on a falling mark back down in grade in 15-runner event at Listowel (7f, good to soft) 8 days ago. Not an obvious one to follow up from 5 lb higher.
Long-standing maiden who was placed for the seventh time this year when third of 14 at Roscommon last month. Not so good at Cork 3 weeks ago, however. Could well bounce back.

Posted her best effort when third of 16 in a Galway nursery for Christopher Timmons in 2024. However, seen only twice for current yard, always behind after 16 months off at Naas just over 5 weeks ago. Back up in trip.
Veteran on a long losing run and his Roscommon fourth is very much a standout this season.
Veteran on a long losing run and shaped as if better for the run after 4 months off when fourth of 14 at Dundalk (1m) recently. Leap of faith required.
9-y-o who has disappointed on 4 of his 5 starts so far this season and others arrive with much more pressing claims. RESERVE.
Little show in 6 starts this season. Handicap mark has tumbled as a result but can only be watched. RESERVE.
On long losing run and never threatened at Cork earlier in the month. Cheekpieces reapplied. RESERVE.

races.name: Invades Day Party Handicap
races.verdict: C&D scorer FILEY BEACH rates the pick of the weights despite being raised 3 lb for his most recent Catterick success so looks the way to go. Monhammer goes very well round here and is a big danger in his bid for a fifth C&D victory, while Misemerald can also have a say.

runners.note: Gained a third win of the season in 11-runner handicap at Catterick (7f, good) 22 days ago. Up 3 lb but this C&D scorer is weighted to go close again.
Notched a fifth success at Ayr (7f) in July. Ran respectably when fourth next time but a below-par ninth of 14 again back there (7f, soft) 13 days ago. Needs a bit more here.

Returned to winning ways at Newcastle in February but form has been mixed since, one of better efforts when fourth of 10 in handicap at Carlisle (7f, good to soft) in June. Needs to hit the ground running after 114 days

Hold-up performer. Notched a fourth C&D success when completing a double last month. Posted another good C&D effort with third of 10 in handicap 18 days ago. A likely player off the same mark.
Completed a hat-trick at Musselburgh (2 over C&D) last summer. Arrives well below par though, beating just one in handicap at Ayr (7f, soft) 13 days ago. Has it to prove at present.
Not the force of old and further decline this year, though mark reflects that and he came as close as he has done to ending his losing run when second at Ayr (7f) on Tuesday. Not ruled out.
Gained a deserved first success of 2026 over 1m here in August. Backed it up with a solid third of 11 in handicap at Thirsk (1m, good) 4 days later. Must enter calculations after a break.
Winless in 2026 and didn't prove easy to catch right for Gary Rutherford. Posted a respectable third of 8 for her new yard in handicap here (1m, good to firm) 18 days ago. Needs to back it up now.
Yet to score in 2026 and arrives under a cloud so best watched at present.

races.name: Gracie's Bar Beginners Chase
races.verdict: HELLO NEIGHBOUR achieved the best hurdles form of these, is related to a multiple-winning chaser and is taken to make a successful debut in this sphere. Putapoundinthejar and Bowensonfire rate the main dangers in what should prove an informative maiden chase.

races.verdict: Lots with chances but RED HUGH O'DONNELL didn't enjoy the rub of the green when sixth in a big field at Listowel last time and can double his tally for the season off a 2 lb lower mark here. Mickey The Steel, Moyassr and Mythical Rock also enter calc

Fair form when third in 6f maiden at the Curragh last October but little encouragement to glean from all 3 starts this summer.

races.name: Dropkicks Split The G Nursery
races.verdict: Most of these arrive with a question mark against them so it could pay to side with BRANDENBURG who had the worst of the draw when well held in a York nursery on his debut for Ann Duffield and had won twice prior to that. The First Drop is weighted to go well if a switch to nursery company sparks a resurgence and is next on the list ahead of Redcar scorer Rock Steady Beat.

runners.note: Fair form in a trio of novices in early summer. Off 11 weeks (gelded) before coming in tenth of 15 on nursery bow at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) 19 days ago. Plenty more is needed in first-time cheekpieces.

Winner of 5f Beverley maiden in May (for Stephen Hanlon) and 6f Hamilton novice in July (for Noel Wilson). Had worst of draw when twelfth of 18 in nursery at York (6f, good) last month for another new yard. Well worth an
Bounced back from 2 poor efforts when getting off the mark in 7-runner seller at Redcar (6f, good to firm) 15 days ago. Not out of things now going handicapping.

Mehmas gelding made a promising debut when third in 6f novice at Chester in May. Has failed to build on it in 4 subsequent starts, however, including on nursery debut when sixth of 13 at Ayr (6f, soft) 12 days ago.

Landed maiden over C&D in August. Backed that up when third in 7f Beverley nursery but failed to beat a rival in another nursery at Ayr (6f, soft) 12 days ago.

races.name: Eddie McAllister Memorial Novice Handicap Chase
races.verdict: MINERS BRIDGE justified strong support with something in hand at Killarney last month and he looks one to keep on the right side following his first chase success. He is taken to get the better of Soldante, who resumed winning ways at Kilbeggan on his latest outing, with Stuntman Steve also considered.

runners.note: Has taken well to chasing this year, winning 2m handicap at Roscommon in June and also forging clear for success in 13-runner contest at Kilbeggan (2½m) early this month. Respected back down in trip.

Has improved over hurdles for current yard this season, getting back to winning ways in 2½m handicap at this venue last month. Has had excuses both starts since, up in grade when mid-field at Listowel (2¼m) 10 days ago.

Got back on track over hurdles when making the frame in handicap at Punchestown (2m) in January. Failed to stay when pulled up at Down Royal (2½m) in March, but has plenty to find as he makes chasing debut after 6 months

Finally off the mark over fences in handicap at Limerick (23f) in May and followed up over hurdles at Tramore. However, has run poorly returned to chasing last 3 starts. Tongue strap refitted back down markedly in trip.

races.name: Bet At racingtv.com Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict: MASABAN produced a career best when making all at Musselburgh last time and, with more still to offer over this trip, he is taken to follow up. Golden Strike arrives on the back of going close at Newmarket and is feared most, ahead of 4-time course winner Evocative Spark.

runners.note: Gained a second win of the season in big-field handicap at York in May and has continued in good heart since, only narrowly denied in 14-runner contest at Newmarket 11 days ago. Merits consideration.

Regular slow starter who managed to win twice over 6f at Newcastle earlier in the year. After 6 months off, probably needed the run when well held at this course 22 days ago, but others still more persuasive.

races.name: Jon Shepherd 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Johnny Sullivan Memorial Maiden
races.verdict: OSTERODE advanced her form when runner-up at Down Royal at the start of the month and looks to have been found an excellent opportunity to go one better for her in-form handler. Dusty Rock has an 8-month absence to overcome but remains likely to do better and could still emerge as the main danger ahead of Famed Again.

runners.note: Prince of Lir gelding. Half-brother to 1m winner Famous Enough. Dam 7f/1m winner who stayed 11.5f. Wears hood. Makes belated debut with others preferred.
Winless in 11 runs. Hasn't stood much racing over the past couple of years and has struggled both starts this summer. Place claims if taking a step forward though.
Long-standing maiden. Yet to fire this season, coming in a never-dangerous fifth of 9 in 6f handicap at Laytown 20 days ago.
Improved from her debut when second of 13 in 5f maiden at Dundalk in January. Absent since but she remains with potential for top yard. Market should prove informative.

Little promise in 2 starts at this track and needs this run for a mark.
Foaled January 23. 450,000 gns yearling. Wootton Bassett colt. First foal of a 1m-10.2f winner related to smart performers. One to take very seriously for top connections in good form right now.

Foaled February 23. €75,000 yearling. Nathaniel colt. Half-brother to numerous winners including smart Thikriyaat and Daban, who won at 7f at 2yrs. Makes appeal on pedigree but has already had breathing operation, so mar

Foaled March 24. €20,000 foal, 105,000 gns yearling. Maxios colt. Half-brother to 1m winner Cymbidium with his dam a half-sister to Prix du Jockey Club winner Study of Man. May need more time but is one to note in the be

Foaled March 4. 240,000 gns yearling. Wootton Bassett colt. Half-brother to very smart winners Glorious Forever (8.3f at 2) and Time Warp (7f-1m at 2). Ticks a lot of boxes so needs considering for top yard.

Foaled March 17. Pinatubo filly, second foal out of a 1½m winner who is a sister to smart winner up to 1½m Pinhole. Well bred but may need longer trips in time and starts out with tongue strap fitted.

races.name: SIS Maiden
races.verdict: MISSISSIPPI SHINE shaped well without being given a hard time when fourth in a big-field Navan maiden on his recent debut and this son of Camelot can take a sizeable step forward over this longer trip and get off the mark. The reliable Pierre Grosse is worth forgiving a rare poor effort at Haydock last time and has the form to go very well, while the high-class chaser Solness has just his third Fl

runners.note: Posted fairly useful efforts when runner-up in Flat maidens at the Curragh and here this spring. Made a successful hurdling debut at Ballinrobe in May but has posted 3 lesser efforts back on the Flat since. A bounce back
Better known as a high-class chaser. Only twice raced in this sphere but came in second of 10 in maiden at Tramore (1½m, good to soft) last month. Needs considering.
125/1, always behind when twelfth of 14 in maiden at Punchestown (9f, good) on her belated debut 15 days ago. Significantly up in trip here.
200/1, last of 15 in maiden at Roscommon (1½m, good to soft) on debut 30 days ago.
Fair maiden. Well below form in handicaps at Newbury and Roscommon in June for Kevin Coleman. Needs this yard switch to spark a resurgence after a break.

Camelot gelding made a promising start with fourth of 21 in maiden at Navan (1¼m, good) 25 days ago, staying on late under hand riding. Open to a fair bit of improvement, especially over this longer trip. Player.
Fairly useful and consistent maiden. Rare poor run in a first-time tongue tie when last of 8 in handicap at Haydock (1¾m, soft) 25 days ago. The sort to bounce back.
Well held in a pair of maidens at Leopardstown (13f) and Listowel (1m) this summer. Goes markedly back up in trip.
300/1, last of 18 in maiden at Navan (1m, good) on debut 25 days ago. Tried over a much longer trip.
Lord Kanaloa filly went backwards from a debut fourth in 1¼m Cork maiden when fifteenth of 21 in maiden at Navan (1¼m, good) 4 weeks agon. Could still do better for top yard stepped up in trip.
Sent off 33/1 and given a considerate introduction when sixth of 11 in juvenile hurdle at Listowel (2m, good) 10 days ago. This Sea Moon filly makes her Flat debut now and the market can guide.

races.name: Sligo Races Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict: WESTERN MODEL shaped well when second over fences at Downpatrick recently and is taken to build on that promise and prove too strong for course specialist Cornmarket and last month's Tramore runner-up Pourquoi Poi. The fact Ballagh Star has won the last 2 runnings of this race means it would be no surprise were he to leave a string of poor efforts behind.

runners.note: Won 3 times over hurdles here last season. Fourth here on his previous chase start. Arrives on the back of a Flat win at Clonmel a fortnight ago. One to consider.
2½m handicap hurdle winner last season who was quickly back to form when second of 10 in handicap chase at Tramore (2¾m, good to firm) 45 days ago. Respected.
Roscommon handicap hurdle winner in July and shaped well when runner-up off his lower chase mark last time, going down only to a progressive sort. Big player.
Unreliable individual who showed clear signs of a revival when third over fences at Roscommon last month but disappointing back hurdling at Galway since.
Veteran who has enjoyed an excellent summer, winning 3 times and placed on 4 other occasions, but a busy spell seemed to catch up with him at Ballinrobe last time.
Modest maiden hurdler who will need to improve for a switch to fences and a significant step up in trip if he's to play a prominent role here.
Doesn't arrive in much form (pulled up on last 3 outings over fences) but the fact he's won this race for the last 2 years means it wouldn't be a shock were he to bounce back with a bang.

Successful again in a point prior to a good run on handicap debut in chase at Tramore (2¾m, good to soft) in May. Likely found the run coming too soon when well held at Roscommon 9 days later. Freshened up since and retu
Off the mark in hurdle at Wexford last August. Plenty of creditable placed efforts in defeat since (including over fences) but latest Ballinrobe hurdle ninth wasn't one of them.
Veteran course scorer who ended a losing run at Clonmel (handicap hurdle) last season. Back to form after a 3-month break with a good third at Kilbeggan in July but has lost his way since.
Maiden who posted her best effort so far when third of 13 in handicap chase at Wexford (25f, soft, 20/1) in first-time cheekpieces 33 days ago. Claims if she can build on that.
Unplaced on all 14 starts under Rules and it is likely best to look elsewhere again.
First form when fifth of 15 in handicap chase at Down Royal (3¼m, good to soft) in April but well held at Kilbeggan 4 months later.

races.name: Racing Again 17th October Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict: Hanging under pressure probably just cost JOJO RABBIT at Pontefract last week given he went down only narrowly to Albegone, so it's reasonable to assume he can reverse the form with that rival and come out on top. So Grateful has been knocking on the door from his reduced mark this season and also needs considering.

runners.note: 4-time C&D scorer who resumed winning ways in 8-runner handicap (7/2) at Pontefract (5f, good) 6 days ago, by short head from Jojo Rabbit. Much respected off same mark.

Gambled on and almost recorded a second win of the season in 8-runner handicap won by reopposing Albegone at Pontefract (5f, good) last week, going down only by a short head after hanging under pressure. Fancied to rever

Given a chance by the assessor and duly took advantage when narrowly winning 6-runner handicap at Ripon (5f) in July. Performed well back up in grade when third behind reopposing Albegone at Musselburgh (5f) and again ra

Won twice off higher marks in 2025 and finished runner-up for a third consecutive start when again touched off by an in-form rival at Yarmouth (6f) in early August. Not seen to best effect at Musselburgh next time and qu

Got back on track dropped to a classified event for the first time when close third at Yarmouth (5f) in August. Done no favours by a hanging rival there next time but had no excuses at Ffos Las latest.
Followed a good run with a below-par one when fifth of 6 in handicap (8/1) at Southwell (5f) 27 days ago. Bounce back called for.
Proved she retains ability after a 9-month absence when third of 5 in handicap at Bath (5f, heavy) last September. Not seen since but clearly capable of going well fresh.
Has offered little all 4 starts this season and easily passed over.

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: JINMAN left his debut form well behind despite still looking rather green when third in a Leicester novice 3 weeks ago and, with the step up to 1m expected to suit, he can build on that and come out on top. Talamon has similarly showed promise and is expected to be on the premises, while Votadini and Sabulo are likely types among the newcomers.

runners.note: 20/1, looked and shaped as if better for run when last of 10 in maiden at Doncaster (1m, good) on debut 18 days ago. Should improve.
Foaled May 20. €68,000 Churchill colt. Closely related to 1¼m winner Unavoidable. Dam once-raced half-sister to useful 1½m winner (stayed 1¾m) Monotype. Newcomer from a top stable.

Green when seventh of 9 on Sandown debut and left that form behind, despite still showing signs of inexperience, when third of 9 over 7f at Leicester (good) 22 days ago. The step up to 1m promises to see him in an even b
Foaled February 10. 72,000 gns Study of Man colt. . Dam, 7f/1m winner, half-sister to useful 8.6f-1¼m winner Persona Grata. Best to look elsewhere unless the betting suggests otherwise.
Foaled March 18. Dubawi colt. Dam smart multiple 7f winner. Makes obvious appeal for top stable in a good vein of form. NON RUNNER.
Looks limited after 2 runs.
Foaled February 14. Frankel colt. Dam, useful 2-y-o 7f winner who stayed 10.5f, sister to smart winner up to 1m Better Together and half-sister to smart winner up to 9f Pocket Square. A likely type.

Foaled March 26. 80,000 gns breeze-up purchase by Starspangledbanner. Dam, 5f/6f winner, half-sister to smart 5f-6f winner Maid In India out of smart 5f-6f winner Indian Maiden. A watching brief is advised on debut unles
150/1 and hooded, last of 9 in novice at this course (7f) on debut 16 days ago, very slowly away. The hood is left off now.
Fair form when third in 7f maiden/novice events at Chepstow and Leicester in recent weeks. Open to further progress now stepping up to 1m.

Foaled March 4. Make Believe colt. Half-brother to useful 1½m winner Chasing Time. Dam, 9f winner (runner-up in Prix de Flore), half-sister to smart winner up to 9f Life In Motion. Newcomer who would need considering if

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap
races.verdict: Oisin Murphy takes over in the saddle on MR FUSTIC who shaped quite well at Wolverhampton last time and is narrowly preferred to Hove Ranger, who has all-weather handicap form figures of 211. Lovely Jubly has posted 2 good efforts over C&D this season and is next on the list.

runners.note: Improved to open her account at the second time of asking at Wolverhampton (7f) last December. Matched that form when fourth there on handicap debut back in May but well held switched to turf at Windsor since.
Been a while since he scored. Best effort this season when close third of 8 in handicap at Lingfield (1¼m, all-weather) last month but stopped quickly back on turf at Leicester since.
Well held in 3 qualifying runs (all-weather) but handicaps provide him with a more realistic chance. There are quite a few winners in his family and he's worth a second look in the betting.

Won 3 times on all-weather for James Ferguson earlier this year, including over C&D. Third under Alice Bond on both starts for new stable, faring best of those held up in a 14-runner contest over C&D latterly.
Failed to finish closer than fifth in 4 maidens in Ireland for Joseph O'Brien and never involved on C&D handicap/yard debut 3 weeks ago. NON RUNNER.

Free-going sort who had race run to suit when back on the scoreboard at Southwell (1m) in March. Best effort since when fourth of 12 at Wolverhampton (8.6f) 15 days ago, keeping on from further back than ideal. This C&D
Second career success when making all on C&D reappearance in July. Creditable third of 10 back here since. Merits consideration.
Reacted well to blinkers when third over 1m at Lingfield (all-weather) in August but the headgear failed to work as well back there next time. A visor is tried now.
Has a 1-21 record and latest 4 lengths sixth of 8 to Hove Ranger at Lingfield doesn't obviously suggest that a second success is imminent.
Struck at the fourth time of asking for new yard when seeing off 7 rivals at Lingfield (1m, all-weather) 18 days ago. Should remain competitive off 3 lb higher.
Maiden who is significantly back down in trip having failed to stay 11.5f at Windsor last time but her mark remains a stiff one.
Won over 7f on handicap debut at Salisbury in June but not kicked on since, faring little better for a first-time visor and step up to 1m last time.,
Course scorer in February. Resumed winning ways returned to all-weather when quickening up well to lead in the dying strides at Lingfield (1¼m) 44 days ago. Considered up 2 lb.
Low-mileage 3-y-o who was a respectable fifth of 9 in handicap (6/1) at Lingfield (1m, all-weather 18 days ago. Being eased another 2 lb can only help.

races.name: Industry Leading In-Play Markets At Unibet Handicap
races.verdict: VENETIAN LION has proved most progressive since a tongue strap was fitted, completing his hat-trick at Pontefract 13 days ago with more in hand than the bare margin so he's going to be tough to stop up 5 lb. Sea Founder makes loads of appeal back up to 1m but isn't the best drawn and may have to settle for a place, while Silent City looks interesting on all-weather debut.

runners.note: Won twice in Italy early last season, including in listed company at Rome, but hasn't recaptured that form. Cheekpieces now reapplied starting out for a new yard and is best watched in the betting.

Twice a winner over this trip last year but didn't get home when sixth of 7 in a handicap at Windsor over 1¼m in July. Returns from 79 days off back at her ideal trip and she could be a big player if taking to all-weathe
Has 2 C&D wins to name, including a 7-runner handicap here 26 days ago. Up 3 lb for that but bigger factor could be his difficult wide draw.
Solid all-weather performer who shaped as if needing run when sixth of 13 over 7f here 26 days ago and can make more impact back up to 1m here.
Better on all-weather and has 3 wins here. Well enough weighted to take a hand but may prove vulnerable to less-exposed rivals at this trip (all career wins at 7f).

Off the mark on all-weather at this course (7f) in July and ran well when second over 1m at Thirsk in August. Best excused latest flop on softer going at York and could well bounce back returned to this venue for top con
Both his wins came over C&D, most recently at a lower level in February, but was a well-beaten tenth of 11 at Salisbury 27 days ago on first start in 3 months. Hard to weigh up.

Much better on all-weather than turf, winning over C&D in April before producing a career best when second of 11 over 7f here in August, finishing well. Flopped on turf last time but should relish this return to 1m and l
Off the mark at Epsom in first-time cheekpieces when dropped in grade in August but last of 6 in a handicap at Lingfield 20 days ago and now has something to prove.

Has proved most progressive since a tongue strap was fitted, completing his hat-trick at Pontefract 13 days ago, quickening to lead entering the final 1f and going clear before being eased. Can take another 5 lb rise in
Won over C&D in February but was out of depth making turf debut over 1¼m when last of 6 in a listed race at Epsom in April. Returns after 155 days off with more in his favour on handicap debut.

Ended run of placed efforts when scoring at Southwell over this trip in April. Disappointed in cheekpieces both starts since, but latest outing came after 5 months off so entitled to come on for it and Billy Loughnane is
Better on all-weather and shaped well when fourth of 7 over C&D in July on return from absence. Trapped wide and below form over 7f here when last seen but now returns to 1m.
Recorded back-to-back thirds at Nottingham and Windsor over 1m in May and June though failed to stay when eighth of 10 in a novice over 11f here in August. Now drops back to 1m for handicap debut.

races.name: ebfstallions.com Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A smart conditions race featuring 3 Group 1 winners. KIND OF BLUE seemingly isn't quite the same force as when winning the Champions Sprint at Ascot a couple of years ago but his second to Elmonjed in a York Group 2 in the spring shows he's still highly talented on his day. He gets a narrow vote over Wise Approach, who should prove suited by the return to 6f, and Mitbaahy.

runners.note: Multiple all-weather scorer who added to his tally at Lingfield (7f) in February before a good second at listed level next time. Creditable 4¼ lengths fourth of 11 to Paborus in Group 3 Chipchase at Newcastle (6f) when l

Smart sort who landed the Champions Sprint at Ascot (soft) in 2024. Showed he's still really smart on his day when second in York Group 2 on reappearance in May. Has come up short in Group 1 company on his 2 outings sinc

Group 2 winner in his prime and placed efforts in a Newbury Group 3 and the Stewards' Cup at Goodwood this summer show he's still smart on his day. Well held in a soft-ground Group 3 in France last time but should have a

2024 Haydock Sprint Cup winner but hasn't come close to scaling the same heights in a light career since. Off since finishing a respectable 4¼ lengths fifth of 10 to Comanche Brave in Group 2 Greenlands at the Curragh in

Talented but quirky. Resumed with very good second in Salisbury 6f listed event, despite looking awkward under pressure. Looked a hard ride again (pulled hard) when below par in another listed event at Newbury 12 days ag

Won 3 times in 2025, including Group 1 Middle Park. Made a disappointing start to current season but better signs last twice, including 2½ lengths fourth of 8 to More Thunder in Group 2 Park Stakes at Doncaster (7f) in f

races.name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap
races.verdict: INTERSTATE didn't enjoy the smoothest of trips when third at Newbury 12 days ago having won in first-time blinkers at Newcastle the time before. He can resume winning ways back on all-weather. Tiernan was possibly unsuited by conditions when sixth at Ayr but had shaped well at this track the time before and is feared most, while Cape Fear is a 3-y-o that could improve further.

runners.note: Three-time course winner who hasn't hit top form yet this year and probably will be vulnerable to younger legs, but this is a marked drop in grade so he may reveal more.
Brought up Flat hat-trick at Southwell in July before third of 12 over 1½m here in August when upped in grade and lost little in defeat. Holds place claims once more.
Off the mark at Hamilton in August and produced good second on all-weather debut over 1½m here 25 days ago. Seemed unsuited by softer going on turf last time and could go well back at this venue.
Boasts a solid all-weather record and can be excused latest turf flop on good to soft going. Now tries first-time blinkers and has a positive jockey booking so could figure.
Won at Windsor in August then ran well when fifth of 9 in a much stronger handicap at Ascot 25 days ago, racing closer to the pace than ideal. One to take very seriously switched to all-weather.
Won a maiden over 7f last August but has struggled in handicaps since, including on this surface last time. Hard to be confident about.

Took advantage of an attractive mark when won 8-runner handicap over 1¼m at Sandown in July. Now 6 lb higher for all-weather debut upped slightly in trip but needs viewing positively given his unexposed nature.

Won on debut at Yarmouth over 1¼m in August, beating a subsequent winner, before producing a good second of 4 at Ripon 30 days ago. Makes his handicap and all-weather debuts here and is open to further improvement.

Off the mark in first-time blinkers at Newcastle 27 days ago and ran even better when third of 8 in a handicap at Newbury 12 days ago, not enjoying the smoothest of trips. Should be suited by this slightly longer trip an
Fairly useful sort but often compromises his chance by not settling. Placed both starts on all-weather but will likely find this beyond him unless he settles down.

races.name: Get Best Odds Guaranteed At Unibet Handicap
races.verdict: BIG BARD served warning that he's ready to strike when running on late over 5f last time and is one to take very seriously back over C&D. Beelzebub isn't long with the Tony Carroll yard so could well have more to offer and looks a big threat, while Southbank is lurking on a good mark again now.

runners.note: Has 2 C&D wins to name with the last coming in January. Hasn't been in top form since but there was a lot more to like over inadequate 5f last time and he's well worth considering back up to 6f and down in 0-55 company.

Won at Windsor in June on first run for new trainer, emphatically ending a long losing run. Best excused latest run after awkward start and he's likely still one to be positive about given the yard he's not long been wit

Won on stable debut in August and ran well from a higher mark later that month but was only fourteenth of 17 in a handicap at Bath 17 days ago when slowly into stride. Lightly raced on all-weather so could bounce back dr
Showed promise when fifth of 11 at Southwell in May, staying on well, but not kicked on since and often starts awkwardly.

Suffered an over-reach when last of 4 in June then ran no sort of race when eleventh of 12 in a handicap over 7f at Lingfield in August, dropping away as if all might not have been well. Best watched with inexperienced r
Fourth of 8 in a Bath handicap 18 days ago, running respectably though her slow-starting issues are becoming ingrained. Plenty more required back on all-weather.
Runner-up over C&D in February but not kicked on since. Bit better than result last 2 starts but still others preferred.

Resumed winning ways at Lingfield over 7f last month and was unlucky when third at Chepstow 30 days ago, badly hampered. Only ran moderately when fifth of 10 at Wolverhampton 12 days ago, though, and now drops back in tr
Fourth of 11 in a handicap at Lingfield over 7f in August but poor efforts both starts since. Hood now applied.

Won over C&D before and is better on all-weather so should come on for recent return from 11 weeks off which took place on turf in first-time cheekpieces. Headgear now removed and back on all-weather. Not best drawn but

Second of 8 in a handicap at Wolverhampton 12 days ago, his best effort since winning in June. Returns to this C&D where twice successful and blinkers are back on. Entitled to go well back down to 6f.
Has lost way this year and needs return to all-weather to spark a revival.
